The '''Hardex system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Jubilar sector/Legends|Jubilar sector]], a part of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] regions known as the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was home to the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Hardex]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="SoR2" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Hardex system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square T-7.<ref name="TEA" />
